body.objective: Turn the conditional charged-time event, finite-resolution and comparison-composition theorems into one exact admissibility contract for action-derived physical receivers and charge-fibre crosswalks, without assuming that the counterflow carrier already supplies one.
body.stop_condition: Import CHARGED_PHYSICAL_TIME_RELATIONAL_EVENT_MAP_THEOREM_V1, CHARGED_TIME_FINITE_RESOLUTION_SAMPLING_THEOREM_V1 and CHARGED_TIME_EMITTER_RECEIVER_COMPOSITION_THEOREM_V1 by exact hashes. Define a receiver object using a local BV cohomology class, descended nonradical pairing period, retarded support map, monotone clock interval, nonzero sampled denominator margin and separately typed D, R_rel and K actions. Define charge-fibre crosswalks, orientation/primitive changes and endpoint identifications as explicit morphisms, and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for representative-independent event evaluation, finite-resolution convergence, reciprocity, transitive composition and loop holonomy. Classify exactly which failures yield zero response, radical/undefined response, unmatched-fibre NO_CERTIFIED_MAP, or loss of causal interpretation. Apply the contract as a fail-closed census to every already certified observer carrier without inventing missing action rows; export a machine-readable receiver/crosswalk interface that the pending full-isotypical counterflow assembly can populate. Supply an independent reconstruction, denominator/orientation/advanced-inverse/charged-generator mutations, strict schema, receipt, report, Paper 09 update and atlas fragment.
body.current_gate: general physical-receiver and charge-fibre interface beneath the conditional comparison algebra
body.forbid: no conditional algebra called a nonzero detector; no radical cohomology period accepted as a receiver; no coordinate ratio called redshift; no advanced inverse used as a physical reverse signal; no unmatched charge fibres composed; no K/raw-D identification; no fixed-Q_rel clock resurrection; no counterflow instantiation before the replacement isotypical health assembly; no nonlinear, particle or quantum promotion
activates: portable observer receiver contract for black-hole and causal-parent consumers
body.resource_hint: INDEPENDENT INTERFACE THEOREM. This work must remain useful even if the counterflow isotypical health assembly terminates at an obstruction. It specifies what a future carrier must provide and audits existing carriers fail closed.
